title: Recall Sum and Difference Identities for Sine
text: Recall $$sin\left(A+B\right)=sin\left(A\right) cos\left(B\right)+cos\left(A\right) sin\left(B\right)$$ and $$sin(A-B)=sin\left(A\right) cos\left(B\right)-cos\left(A\right) sin\left(B\right)$$.

title: Apply the identities
text: Substitute the identities into the left side of the expression.
